_about: Hand-labeled listing-title pairs for the deterministic matcher. Labels are human judgement of whether the two titles describe the same purchasable item: exact = same product AND same variant, both stated; likely = nothing conflicts but one side leaves a variant attribute unstated; similar = same brand/family, different variant or model; different = different product. Titles are written in the style of Vietnamese marketplace listings; they are test fixtures, not retrieved data.
